fields.hotWashTransition: Thank you, everyone. Ten minutes, then the hot wash.
fields.hotWashMethod: 3-Up, 3-Down: three things that went well, three that did not
hotWashQuestions: How fast did the Group prove its fleet was grounded, and with what evidence?
Was “no Group aircraft were flying” the right answer at 11:15? At 13:15?
What did you decide to say once the operator was identified, and why?
What should change about personal flights near Group sites and fair-week gate codes?
Did anyone want to launch or approach the drone? What stopped them?

snapshot.title: Drone Apprehended — Incident Closed

fields.resolution: ENDEX. The drone has been located and the operator is in custody. All operations have resumed under written restart criteria. The incident is closed. The hot wash begins.
finalState: The drone identified as 'RID-BM-12-004' has been secured by Harwick Police and handed over to the Group's security team under ERP-1001.
All Group aircraft remain grounded pending final verification and the IC's confirmation of full system integrity.
The incident folder on HUOG-NAS01 (\HUOG-NAS01\ops\incident-log\2026-10-25-120502-0045) is complete and contains all logs, photos, and correspondence per C2.
The General Manager has approved the restart of operations at 14:30, and all pre-flight checks are complete for the next campaign.
The Incident Commander has declared the event closed and initiated the hot wash per HUOG-ERP Section 11.4.
fields.hotWashTransition: Thank you, everyone. Put down your phones and radios. We will take ten minutes, then start the hot wash.
fields.hotWashMethod: 3-Up, 3-Down: three things that went well, three things that broke
hotWashQuestions: What actions in the response prevented a media escalation?
How did the team maintain operational integrity while under pressure from law enforcement and public scrutiny?
What was the most critical factor in confirming the drone was not a Group asset?
How did the chain of command handle conflicting input from the GM, FSDO, and local law enforcement?
What would you change in the incident folder documentation process to improve retention and audit readiness?
